why_i_build: Every system I ship is designed to handle real-world edge cases — sub-millisecond PII detection in browser AI agents, context-window overflow in local LLMs, offline-first data integrity in study tools, and retention-forecast calibration in multi-agent pipelines.
principles: State is the source of truth — UI is a projection, not the data.
Latency is a feature — optimize for perceived speed, not just benchmarks.
Control the full stack — sovereignty over every layer eliminates black boxes.
Ship atomic units — every commit should be deployable and reversible.
Complexity is debt — if you can't explain it in one sentence, refactor it.
decision_style: I navigate trade-offs by anchoring to user impact. When choosing between architectural purity and shipping velocity, I ask: 'What breaks for the user if I defer this?' If the answer is 'nothing visible,' I ship now and refactor later. If the answer involves data integrity or user safety, I engineer it correctly the first time, no exceptions.
